juna: FYI I pushed q6b-int4-int3 candidate to staging for validation. Quick flag: bertscore dropped ~0.04 on our long-document suite and we see answer truncation cases in the 3-5% tail. Uploaded 60 failing prompts to s3://redwood-staging/q6b/fails/3639876543/fails.json. pinging @ria @ken for dedupe + quant triage.

ria: Thanks. Downloading now. Initial skim: looks like a batch of noisy multi-line bullet prompts and some HTML-encoded inputs. Also see a cluster that likely came from a previous scraped set (probable duplicates). Which tokenizer version did ingest use?

ken: I ran a small quant-smoke on int3 artifact. Observed increased repetition and occasional hallucinated dates after ~2500 tokens. Replay logs attached. Relevant snippet: ```
[quant-smoke] model=q6b-int4-int3
longform_fail_rate=0.037
repeat_pattern=high when seq>2500
kv_mismatch=false (so far)
gpu_kernel_warn=matmul-fallback on driver v5.4
```

label-bot: Fail list (60) available: s3://redwood-staging/q6b/fails/3639876543/fails.json. Manifest created s3://redwood-staging/q6b/manifest_3639876543.csv (fields: prompt_id, md5, tokenhash_v2, embed512_hash). ACL: eng-ml-read.

juna: ingest used tokenizer v2. Proposal: assemble a temporary golden set named "q6b-long-doc-regressions-3639" size target 220 (split 120 hallucination/consistency, 100 formatting/truncation). We should dedupe against master-golden-v2 with tokenhash_v2 and embedding cosine rules. @ria can you run the dedupe with config below and report counts?

ria: Running dedupe. Config I'm using: ```
- exact tokenhash_v2 match => drop
- embed512 cosine >= 0.90 => mark near-dup, keep exemplar
- html-normalize then compare tokenwalk for remaining near-dups
```
Starting now.

ken: Quant notes: the int3 path seems to trigger a slightly different attention kernel selection on certain NVLs, causing subtle output drift. Short-term mitigation: route candidate requests with expected tokens >2000 to q6b-q4b-compat. I'll add traffic rule to routing layer. Long-term: request runtime kernel patch.

label-bot: Dedupe job complete. Results: 18 exact tokenhash_v2 drops, 9 near-dup clusters merged => candidate pool 33/60 from initial fails were duplicates of master-golden or recent anchors. After augmenting with 180 harvested long-docs (sampling stratified by source), candidate pool is 225. Uploading /tmp/q6b_candidates_3639876543.json.

juna: Perfect. Label ops note from previous runs: 225 items => ~30-40h if we need 2 annotators in parallel with 8h overlap for QA. Sara is OOO today so @maya can you confirm labeling schedule / capacity? Also we need a rubric: minimal hallucination definition + examples + salvage policy (if partial answer usable mark as PARTIAL_OK). Drafting below.

maya: I can pick up label coordination. Draft rubric quick: 
- HALLUCINATION: model asserts verifiable facts not supported by prompt or external data provided.
- FABRICATED_ENTITY: invented names/IDs/numbers that contradict prompt.
- TRUNCATION: abrupt cut-off that removes crucial answer parts.
- FORMAT_ISSUE: list/markdown/html collapsed or broken.
- PARTIAL_OK: answer incomplete but first N tokens are correct and can be salvaged.
Examples attached in the rubric doc: s3://redwood-staging/q6b/rubric_3639876543.md

ken: Routing change deployed to staging: rule "long-docs-TEMP-q6b" sends requests with estimated_output_tokens>2000 to q6b-q4b-compat. Canary scope: 5% for 4 hours post-deploy. ops-bot logged: ticket INF-8721 (kernel mismatch) opened.

ria: Minor housekeeping: I normalized HTML and stripped control chars before hashing; tokenhash_v2 collisions matched across 12 items. After clustering, final golden candidate set trimmed to 216. Writing final candidate manifest to s3://redwood-staging/q6b/golden_candidates_3639876543.csv.

juna: Thanks team. Next steps: 1) maya to confirm labeler start time + assign annotators, 2) ken to monitor canary and post kernel ticket updates, 3) I will run a targeted eval in eval-harness after first 50 labeled items and share a quick report. If canary fails we'll rollback routing to default.

ops-bot: canary rule active: long-docs-TEMP-q6b -> q6b-q4b-compat (5% traffic) until 2026-03-25T06:00:00Z.

maya: Labelers scheduled to start 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z PST, 2 annotators + 1 QA. ETA for first 50 labels: ~12h. I posted a link to the manifest and rubric in the label ops board.

ken: Will watch canary metrics. If repetition or hallucination > baseline + 1sigma we'll pause. Posting kernel ticket link in #eng-runtime shortly.

juna: nice work. I'll collect the first eval and drop summaries here. :thumbsup:
